provenance.gpu_pj_per_flop: B200 dense FP16 ~2.25 PFLOP/s at ~1 kW board => 0.44 pJ/FLOP at peak; 0.40 used for logic. Consistent with Horowitz ISSCC'14 scaled to 4 nm. Swept 0.20-0.80.
provenance.hbm_pj_per_byte: Ujeniya et al. arXiv:2604.11391, nvidia-smi memory-rail readings. H200 (HBM3e, same generation as B200): 220 W memory-bound Triad vs 110 W DGEMM = 110 W activity-attributed over 4.89 TB/s = 22.5 pJ/B. Independently corroborated by FlashAccel's cited HBM3e 2.99 pJ/bit = 23.9 pJ/B. Swept 11.9-28.0.
provenance.hbf_program_read_ratio: HBFSim energy_table.toml, 100 us program vs 10 us read.
provenance.nma_pj_per_mac: FP16 MAC at 16 nm, Horowitz-scaled. Swept 0.10-1.00.
provenance.idle_w_per_gpu: B200 idle board power. Swept 100-250 W.
provenance.d2d_link_pj_per_byte: short-reach on-package D2D / HBFSim host bus.
